info.title: ProgramKit Event API
info.description: The event-scoped integration API for ProgramKit. Every named write uses the same authorization, validation, idempotency, and audit path as the web application.

tags.name: Exports
tags.description: Portable workspace exports and domain events.

tags.name: Named operations
tags.description: Authorized, idempotent event mutations generated from the core manifest.

200.description: The current schema and workspace revision.

get.description: Returns the canonical operation manifest. Some staff- or demo-only operations cannot be granted to an API key and are therefore not exposed as write paths in this document.

operations.name: event.update
operations.title: Update event settings
operations.description: Update the active event identity, logo, venue, dates, timezone, or lifecycle status.

operations.name: track.create
operations.title: Create program track
operations.description: Add a named, color-coded track to the active event.

operations.name: room.create
operations.title: Create event room
operations.description: Add a schedulable room and capacity to the active event.

operations.name: session.create
operations.title: Create program session
operations.description: Create a draft or approved session and connect its speakers to it.

operations.name: session.update
operations.title: Update program session
operations.description: Update session content, format, track, speakers, or approval status.

operations.name: session.restore
operations.title: Restore session version
operations.description: Restore session content and settings from a recorded change.

operations.name: submission-form.create
operations.title: Create submission form
operations.description: Create an event-scoped CFP or guaranteed-session form and its ordered fields.

operations.name: submission-form.update
operations.title: Update submission form
operations.description: Update form settings or atomically replace its ordered fields and conditional rules.

operations.name: submission-form.publish
operations.title: Publish submission form
operations.description: Validate and open a submission form at its public slug.

operations.name: submission.create
operations.title: Create submission draft
operations.description: Create a private draft response to an open event submission form.

operations.name: submission.submit
operations.title: Submit proposal
operations.description: Validate a draft, submit it, and assign its first evaluation round.

operations.name: submission.update
operations.title: Update submission
operations.description: Update a speaker-owned proposal, its files, or its co-presenters.

operations.name: reviewer.create
operations.title: Add reviewer
operations.description: Add a reviewer to the active event.

operations.name: reviewer-team.create
operations.title: Create reviewer pool
operations.description: Create an event-scoped reviewer pool for an evaluation round.

operations.name: reviewer-team.update
operations.title: Update reviewer pool
operations.description: Rename a reviewer pool or replace its event-scoped membership.

operations.name: evaluation-plan.create
operations.title: Create evaluation plan
operations.description: Create an event review plan with independent rounds, category routing, pools, and scorecards.

operations.name: evaluation-plan.update
operations.title: Update evaluation plan
operations.description: Update review rounds, dates, category routes, reviewer pools, identity rules, and scorecards.

operations.name: review.assign
operations.title: Assign reviews
operations.description: Assign one or more eligible submissions to a reviewer, with optional track filters and a reviewer cap.

operations.name: review.unassign
operations.title: Remove review assignment
operations.description: Remove an incomplete reviewer assignment from the active event.

operations.name: review.remind
operations.title: Remind reviewers
operations.description: Send a reminder to reviewers who still have outstanding assignments.

operations.name: review.recuse
operations.title: Declare review conflict
operations.description: Recuse the assigned reviewer from one proposal while preserving an audit trail.

operations.name: review.restore-recusal
operations.title: Undo review conflict
operations.description: Restore a recused proposal to the assigned reviewer’s actionable queue.

operations.name: review.submit-scorecard
operations.title: Submit review scorecard
operations.description: Score an assigned submission against its evaluation plan rubric.

operations.name: review.decide
operations.title: Decide submission
operations.description: Accept, reject, or waitlist a reviewed submission; acceptance creates the speaker and session records.

operations.name: submission.notify-decision
operations.title: Queue decision email
operations.description: Render and queue the recorded submission decision for its submitter.

operations.name: person.create
operations.title: Create person
operations.description: Create a person and an event participation record.

operations.name: person.add-note
operations.title: Add contact note
operations.description: Add an internal, timestamped note to an organization contact.

operations.name: person.add-to-event
operations.title: Add contact to event
operations.description: Reuse an organization contact in an event without re-entering profile data.

operations.name: person.reuse-in-event
operations.title: Reuse contact in active event
operations.description: Reuse a known organization contact in the active event while preserving their stable identity.

operations.name: person.merge
operations.title: Merge duplicate contacts
operations.description: Merge a duplicate person into a chosen primary contact and preserve links.

operations.name: crm.segment.create
operations.title: Save CRM segment
operations.description: Save a dynamic filter or curated contact set as a reusable segment.

operations.name: crm.pipeline.enroll
operations.title: Enroll speaker prospect
operations.description: Add an organization contact to the speaker sourcing pipeline.

operations.name: crm.pipeline.move
operations.title: Move speaker prospect
operations.description: Move a speaker prospect to another sourcing stage and record the transition.

operations.name: crm.pipeline.add-note
operations.title: Add pipeline note
operations.description: Add a timestamped internal note to a speaker sourcing card.

operations.name: crm.outreach.queue
operations.title: Queue CRM outreach
operations.description: Queue one personalized message for each selected organization contact.

operations.name: person.import
operations.title: Import people
operations.description: Import speaker profiles into the active event and skip existing email addresses.

operations.name: person.update
operations.title: Update person
operations.description: Update contact or public profile fields for a person.

operations.name: asset.register
operations.title: Register uploaded asset
operations.description: Attach uploaded file metadata to an active-event record.

operations.name: asset.delete
operations.title: Delete stored file
operations.description: Hide an uploaded file, retain its audit metadata, and mark its stored bytes for cleanup.

operations.name: asset.confirm-deletion
operations.title: Confirm stored file cleanup
operations.description: Record that the host removed a deleted file from private object storage.

operations.name: asset.comment
operations.title: Comment on file
operations.description: Add an attributed comment to an uploaded file.

operations.name: participation.set-status
operations.title: Set participation status
operations.description: Move a participant through the invitation and confirmation lifecycle.

operations.name: participation.update-logistics
operations.title: Update speaker logistics
operations.description: Store private travel and logistics notes for an event participant.

operations.name: requirement.create
operations.title: Create participant task
operations.description: Create a dated task and assign it to selected event participants.

operations.name: requirement.set-status
operations.title: Review requirement
operations.description: Submit, approve, waive, or request revision on a readiness requirement.

operations.name: requirement.process-reminders
operations.title: Process automatic task reminders
operations.description: Queue due reminder messages for incomplete speaker tasks.

operations.name: portal.update-profile
operations.title: Update participant profile
operations.description: Allow a participant to update their own public profile fields.

operations.name: portal-resource.create
operations.title: Create speaker resource
operations.description: Create a draft or published resource page for the speaker portal.

operations.name: portal-resource.update
operations.title: Update speaker resource
operations.description: Update, publish, or archive a speaker portal resource page.

operations.name: program-embed.create
operations.title: Save program embed
operations.description: Save a named public-program view or feed for reuse outside the organizer app.

operations.name: program-embed.update
operations.title: Update program embed
operations.description: Rename, enable, or disable a saved public-program embed.

operations.name: schedule.place-session
operations.title: Place session
operations.description: Assign an unscheduled session to a room and start time.

operations.name: schedule.move-session
operations.title: Move session
operations.description: Move a session to another room or start time and recalculate conflicts.

operations.name: schedule.auto-place
operations.title: Auto-place sessions
operations.description: Place unscheduled sessions into the earliest conflict-free rooms and times.

operations.name: schedule.publish
operations.title: Publish schedule
operations.description: Publish the current conflict-free schedule as a new immutable version.

operations.name: campaign.send-portal-invite
operations.title: Send speaker portal invitation
operations.description: Queue one personalized speaker portal invitation and record it in communications history.

operations.name: campaign.create-draft
operations.title: Draft campaign
operations.description: Create a targeted message draft with a calculated audience.

operations.name: campaign.submit
operations.title: Submit campaign
operations.description: Submit a campaign for human approval.

operations.name: campaign.approve
operations.title: Approve campaign
operations.description: Approve an exact campaign version and recipient set.

operations.name: campaign.send
operations.title: Send campaign
operations.description: Record and enqueue an approved campaign for delivery.

operations.name: campaign.cancel
operations.title: Cancel campaign
operations.description: Cancel a draft, submitted, or approved campaign before it is queued.

operations.name: communications.cancel-message
operations.title: Cancel queued message
operations.description: Stop one queued or retrying outbound message before provider acceptance.

operations.name: communications.suppress-email
operations.title: Suppress email address
operations.description: Stop unsent messages and block future outbound email to one address.

operations.name: communications.remove-suppression
operations.title: Remove email suppression
operations.description: Allow future outbound email to a previously suppressed address.

operations.name: change-set.create
operations.title: Create change set
operations.description: Create a reviewable proposal containing one or more operations.

operations.name: change-set.approve
operations.title: Approve change set
operations.description: Approve a validated proposal for commit.

operations.name: change-set.reject
operations.title: Reject change set
operations.description: Reject a proposed change set without applying its operations.

operations.name: change-set.commit
operations.title: Commit change set
operations.description: Revalidate and atomically apply an approved proposal.

operations.name: workspace.reset-demo
operations.title: Reset demo workspace
operations.description: Replace the workspace with the deterministic demonstration dataset.

get.description: Returns newest accepted events first. This is an operator feed, not a webhook delivery guarantee.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of newest events to return.
